title: Financial Analyst
description: We are looking for a Financial Analyst to support financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and business analysis activities.
responsibilities: Prepare financial reports and management reports.
Analyze revenue, expenses, and financial performance.
Perform variance analysis between actual and budgeted results.
Develop and maintain Excel-based financial models.
Analyze business data using SQL and other analytical tools.
Create dashboards and reports for management.
Assist with financial planning and business analysis.
